title: Normalization Constant
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly calculate the normalization constant C as 1/3.

title: L2 Expectation Value
description: Important Criteria: The student must derive the expectation value of L^2 as 82 hbar^2.

title: Lz Expectation Value
description: Important Criteria: The student must derive the expectation value of L_z as hbar.

title: Lx2 Expectation Value
description: Important Criteria: The student must calculate the expectation value of L_x^2 correctly.

title: Time Evolution State
description: Important Criteria: The student must find the correct time-evolved state and recognize that L^2 and L_z remain unchanged.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common errors such as sign mistakes or incorrect normalization.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should ensure that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.
